construct: A participant who has not experienced the event when observation ends contributes information to the risk set through the last known event-free time and is then censored. Excluding the participant entirely discards valid follow-up information, whereas counting censoring as an event falsely lowers estimated survival.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A subject known event-free through 18 months and then lost to follow-up has a right-censored time-to-event observation.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Excluding the subject loses valid observed follow-up; counting censoring as an event creates a false survival decrement; assuming event-free status after loss invents data.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Kaplan-Meier handling is uniquely to include the subject in the risk set through the last known event-free time and censor thereafter.
